metaData.title: Xiaomi MiMo， Explore and Love
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Xiaomi MiMo and TileRT achieve 1000+ tokens/s inference on a 1-trillion-parameter model using commodity GPUs through extreme model-system codesign, including FP4 quantization and DFlash speculative decoding.
metaData.summary: This article announces the release of Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed, a 1-trillion-parameter model capable of over 1000 tokens/s decode speed, achieved through deep collaboration between the MiMo model team and the TileRT inference system team. The key technical innovations include: (1) selective FP4 quantization of MoE Experts to dramatically reduce model size while preserving capability; (2) DFlash, a block-level masked parallel prediction method for speculative decoding that achieves high acceptance lengths (6.30 in coding scenarios); and (3) TileRT's paradigm-level execution model with persistent engine kernels and warp specialization, eliminating operator boundary overhead. The model is available via a limited-time, application-based API from June 9-23, 2026, at 3x the cost of the standard model but delivering approximately 10x the generation speed. The checkpoint has been open-sourced on HuggingFace. The article argues that breaking 1000 tps at the trillion-parameter scale represents a paradigm shift, enabling real-time decision loops, multi-path reasoning, and dramatically accelerated coding agents.

mainPoints.point: Achieving 1000+ tps on a 1T model using commodity GPUs, not specialized hardware.
mainPoints.explanation: The team achieved this through model-system codesign: FP4 quantization of MoE Experts and DFlash speculative decoding on the model side, combined with TileRT's persistent kernel and warp specialization execution model on the system side, all running on a single standard 8-GPU node.

mainPoints.point: Selective FP4 quantization of MoE Experts is key to reducing memory bandwidth without significant quality loss.
mainPoints.explanation: By quantizing only the MoE Experts (the majority of parameters with highest quantization tolerance) to FP4 while preserving original precision for other modules, the model size is dramatically reduced. QAT training ensures capability remains essentially on par with the original.

mainPoints.point: DFlash speculative decoding uses block-level masked parallel prediction to overcome the draft model bottleneck.
mainPoints.explanation: Instead of autoregressive drafting, DFlash fills an entire block of masked positions in a single forward pass. Combined with Sliding Window Attention and GPU-local training, it achieves high acceptance lengths (6.30 in coding) while keeping the draft model lightweight.

mainPoints.point: TileRT's execution model eliminates operator boundary overhead at the microsecond scale.
mainPoints.explanation: The persistent engine kernel keeps the entire compute pipeline resident on the GPU, enabling continuous prefetching and overlap of data movement with computation. Warp specialization decomposes communication, data movement, and tensor computation for precise, heterogeneous execution.

mainPoints.point: 1000 tps at 1T scale enables new AI application paradigms beyond faster text generation.
mainPoints.explanation: Speed enables real-time multi-path reasoning (Best-of-N / Tree Search), dramatically accelerates coding agents, and allows trillion-parameter models to enter time-critical decision loops like high-frequency trading, anti-fraud, and surgical assistance.

keyQuotes: When a model is fast enough, it ceases to be a tool you wait on and becomes an extension of your own thinking: responding in real time, iterating in an instant, collaborating without friction.
AI speed is no longer just a metric of efficiency --- it becomes a chip in the race against death.

The birth of 1000 tokens/s is no coincidence of point optimizations. It is the inevitable result of world-class system infrastructure and extreme algorithmic models deeply converging toward each other, co-evolving as one.

relatedArticles.title: Dreaming: Better memory for a more helpful ChatGPT
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI announces a major upgrade to ChatGPT's memory system, using a more scalable 'dreaming' architecture that automatically synthesizes memories from chat history to improve freshness, continuity, and relevance.

relatedArticles.title: Cursor and SpaceX Partner to Scale AI Coding with Stargate-Class Infrastructure
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Cursor CEO Michael Truell announces a strategic partnership with SpaceX to leverage massive compute infrastructure for scaling the Cursor Composer and building advanced coding models.

relatedArticles.title: Harness engineering: leveraging Codex in an agent-first world
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI engineers detail a five-month experiment building a production software product with zero manually-written code, using Codex agents to achieve 10x velocity and redefining the engineer's role as system designer and feedback loop architect.

relatedArticles.title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-5.5: A New Class of Intelligence for Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI announces GPT-5.5, a new model designed for complex goal understanding and autonomous task completion, now available in ChatGPT and Codex.

relatedArticles.title: Games between Programs: The Ruliology of Competition
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically explores the 'ruliology of competition' by exhaustively enumerating and testing all possible strategies (finite state machines, cellular automata, Turing machines) in repeated two-player games, revealing that winning strategies are neither consistently simple nor complex, but depend on detailed structure.

relatedArticles.title: Trees to Flows and Back: Unifying Decision Trees and Diffusion Models
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This paper establishes a mathematical correspondence between hierarchical decision trees and diffusion processes, unifying them under a shared optimization principle called Global Trajectory Score Matching (GTSM).

relatedArticles.title: Inside FAISS: Billion-Scale Similarity Search
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides a deep, visual, and intuitive explanation of FAISS, covering the core ideas of IVF, Product Quantization, their combination in IVFPQ, and GPU acceleration, to enable billion-scale similarity search.

relatedArticles.title: Algorithmic Monocultures in Hiring
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This study analyzes 3.4 million real job applicants to demonstrate that algorithmic monocultures in hiring—where many employers use the same vendor's AI—cause systemic rejections and previously overlooked racial disparities against Asian and Black applicants.

relatedArticles.title: Andrej Karpathy on Code Agents， AutoResearch， and the Loopy Era of AI
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Andrej Karpathy explores the paradigm shift from manual programming to agent orchestration, the automation of AI research, and the profound implications for software engineering and education.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing GPT-5.5
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.5, a new category of AI that acts as an autonomous agent capable of planning, reasoning, and executing complex multi-step tasks across different applications.
